_readme: Not a parameter of its own. Merge these three entries into the host's ads parameter (ads_config, and its debug twin) under BOTH organic.screenWiseAds and marketing.screenWiseAds. The ad SDK reads adType / loadType / adData / adDataList; the launcher itself reads the two extra fields, reload_ad_on_open (default true) and app_drawer.ad_row_position (default 0). isActive=false hides a slot without calling the SDK at all; a key missing entirely leaves the slot GONE. The adIds below are Google test units - swap them before release.

adData.notes: Native - bottom of the app-search panel (fling left)
Native - middle of the app-search panel, under the suggested apps
Native - a full-span row inside the app drawer, at ad_row_position
